limits: Temporary homes and synthetic canaries. The scan catches known shapes only: as the SPEC-074 privacy review says, pattern-based redaction cannot catch every secret shape or every piece of personal data (for example names in free text). Not detected, by owner decision OD-3 Q2 A: a literal secret the store was not given at ingest, free text of unknown shape, a raw attempt id typed inside content, and encodings nested twice or more; canaryScan clean means no hit for the listed classes, not free of secrets. The home-path check refuses any /Users/<name> or /home/<name> path not inside a longer segment, so a trace that mentions any such path (for example /home/runner/ on CI when it is not the current $HOME, /srv/home/x or a URL path /api/users/42) blocks the export until the run is cleaned or purged. The current-home check depends on $HOME at export time (Path.home()); the SPEC-074 adapter redacts the $HOME current at read time. SPEC-074 is not changed.
